ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which reason best explains why we greet one another? (1 mark)
   A. It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
   B. It is only needed when we meet strangers
   C. It is only needed by adults
   D. It is only needed at school

2. What does the Arabic word سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) mean? (1 mark)
   A. window
   B. knife
   C. cup
   D. door

3. Which is a fault in handwriting? (1 mark)
   A. Letters on the baseline
   B. Correct dots
   C. Wide gaps inside a word
   D. Even spaces between words

4. What does the Arabic sentence هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. A gift for Amina.
   B. On the table there is a cake.
   C. This is a party.
   D. Above the table there is a balloon.

5. What does the Arabic word خُبْزٌ (khubz) mean? (1 mark)
   A. bread
   B. apples
   C. fruit
   D. vegetables

6. Which word means 'above'? (1 mark)
   A. taHta
   B. fii
   C. ʿalaa
   D. fawqa

7. Which ending shows that you are speaking to a boy? (1 mark)
   A. -ii
   B. -na
   C. -ka
   D. -ki

8. Which word means 'with' in bi-yadii? (1 mark)
   A. yad
   B. fii
   C. bi
   D. ii

9. Which Arabic word means "hand"? (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسٌ
   B. يَدٌ
   C. لِسَانٌ
   D. وَجْهٌ

10. What is the name of the Arabic letter خ? (1 mark)
   A. thaa
   B. taa
   C. khaa
   D. qaaf

11. What does the Arabic word عَمٌّ (ʿamm) mean? (1 mark)
   A. father's sister
   B. father's brother
   C. grandmother
   D. mother's brother

12. What does the Arabic sentence الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I go to school on Monday.
   B. I play on Saturday.
   C. There are seven days in a week.
   D. Today is Thursday.

13. How wide should the space between two words be? (1 mark)
   A. No space at all
   B. As wide as a line
   C. About the width of one letter
   D. As wide as a word

14. Which Arabic word means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. الْخَمِيسُ
   B. دَجَاجٌ
   C. تَفَضَّلْ
   D. كَبِيرٌ

15. What does the Arabic sentence أَبِي يَعْمَلُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. This is my mother.
   C. My father works.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: ashrabu l-haliiba (2 marks)

17. List the six Arabic letters that do not join to the letter that follows them. (3 marks) (3 marks)

18. Explain how to build a vocabulary bank for the theme of the body. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: al-jawwu mumtir (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: al-baytu kabiir (2 marks)

21. Write one Arabic sentence about a household item using a describing word, and translate it. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — It shows respect and kindness to the person we meet
   A greeting is for everyone. It shows that we see and respect the other person.

2. B — knife
   سِكِّينٌ (sikkiin) means knife.

3. C — Wide gaps inside a word
   Wide gaps inside a word make it look like several words.

4. A — A gift for Amina.
   هَدِيَّةٌ لِأَمِينَةَ (hadiyya li-Aminata) means: A gift for Amina.

5. A — bread
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

6. D — fawqa
   fawqa means above. taHta means under, fii means in and ʿalaa means on.

7. C — -ka
   The ending -ka is used when speaking to a boy or man, as in kayfa haaluka?

8. C — bi
   bi means 'with', so bi-yadii is 'with my hand'.

9. B — يَدٌ
   يَدٌ (yad) means hand.

10. C — khaa
   The letter خ is called khaa.

11. B — father's brother
   عَمٌّ (ʿamm) means father's brother.

12. D — Today is Thursday.
   الْيَوْمُ يَوْمُ الْخَمِيسِ (al-yawmu yawmu l-khamiis) means: Today is Thursday.

13. C — About the width of one letter
   A small even space keeps words apart without breaking the sentence.

14. D — كَبِيرٌ
   كَبِيرٌ (kabiir) means big.

15. C — My father works.
   أَبِي يَعْمَلُ (abii yaʿmalu) means: My father works.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: I drink milk.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: alif, daal, dhaal, raa, zaay and waaw.
   Working / marking points: 3 marks for all six; 2 marks for four or five; 1 mark for two or three.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Write each new word with its sound and meaning, add a small drawing, and keep the words on cards or a page for practice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: The weather is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The house is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example al-baabu kabiir. The door is big.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence, 1 mark for a matching describing word and 1 mark for the translation.
